# Quiverspire — upstream attribution

Adapted from Andrew Wooldridge / triptych, `web-games-andrew/game-046`.

- Upstream: https://github.com/triptych/web-games-andrew/tree/a7051c34fe2e7550fd206e6272f758df171855b0/game-046
- Fixed commit: `a7051c34fe2e7550fd206e6272f758df171855b0`
- Original game design, simulation, procedural art and audio: Andrew Wooldridge (2026).
- License: MIT, reproduced in full below.
- pureTV changes: nine-key Wi-Fi controller bridge, TV-safe layout, remote menu focus, suspend/cancel handling, offline packaging and read-only QA observations. Original rules and simulation retained.
- Google Fonts replaced with system fonts; optional website/PWA/share links and shared website helpers removed. No network assets are required.

Three.js 0.165.0 (the original CDN version), bundled locally.
